LanguageData.Grechka_CaravanDroneT1_Unit.label: caravan drone T1
LanguageData.Grechka_CaravanDroneT1_Unit.description: Fireproof caravan hauling drone T1. Carries up to 50 kg and performs ordinary hauling at the colony. Converts food to energy: 2 nutrition stores one day of activity. Can also charge at its own powered dock. A flat battery stops ordinary work without destroying the drone or cargo.
LanguageData.Grechka_CaravanDroneStationT1_Dock.label: caravan drone dock T1
LanguageData.Grechka_CaravanDroneStationT1_Dock.descr: Charging and repair dock with a caravan drone T1. The drone hauls at the colony and carries up to 50 kg in caravans, using food as fuel. A travelling drone remains linked to this dock.
